name: get_project
description: Return the full current project: parts (with pins, the net each pin is on and what it touches), wires, board-pin bindings, educational check issues, the program as Block IR and the active view. Call this before modifying an existing project or when unsure about ids.

name: add_part
description: Add a part from the parts library to the canvas. Returns the new part id. With placement 'breadboard' (default 'auto' tries the breadboard for insertable parts) its legs are inserted into free breadboard columns and the result lists which hole each pin landed in. Boards (arduino-uno, esp32c6-devkit) and the breadboard are placed automatically in free space. Only one board per project.

type.description: Part type id from the catalog, e.g. 'led', 'resistor', 'arduino-uno'.

label.description: Optional human label in Spanish, e.g. 'LED rojo'.

near.description: Optional part id to place it close to.

name: remove_part
description: Remove a part and every wire attached to it.

name: update_part
description: Change a part's properties (e.g. LED color, resistor value), label or rotation (0/90/180/270).

name: move_part
description: Move a part to an absolute grid position (1 unit = 0.1 inch). Rarely needed; add_part places parts automatically.

name: connect
description: Connect two pins with a jumper wire. Pin refs are '<partId>.<pinId>' e.g. 'led1.anode', 'uno1.D13', 'uno1.GND1', 'bb1.a10' (breadboard hole), 'bb1.T+3' (top + rail). If a part pin is inserted in the breadboard the wire is attached to a free hole of the same breadboard strip, like a real build. Use red for positive supply, black for ground.

name: disconnect
description: Remove a wire by id, or every wire directly between two pins.

name: set_program
description: Replace the block program with the given Block IR (see the Block IR reference in the system prompt). The block editor is updated so the student sees the blocks. Prefer part-level nodes (led, buttonPressed, servo…) that reference part ids over raw pins. Returns the generated Arduino C++ and warnings.

name: get_code
description: Return the Arduino C++ code generated from the current blocks.

name: run_checks
description: Run the educational electrical checks (short circuits, LED without resistor, reversed LED, GPIO over-current, missing common ground, 5V on a 3.3V board…) and return the issues.

name: simulate
description: Run the circuit + program headlessly for duration_ms (max 20000) and return a timeline of part state changes (LED on/off and brightness, motor speed, servo angle, buzzer) and serial output. Optional inputs press buttons / turn knobs at given times, e.g. {"atMs":1000,"part":"btn1","prop":"pressed","value":true}.

name: compile
description: Compile the generated code with arduino-cli for the project's board on the server. Returns success, diagnostics and memory usage. Takes 5-60 s.

name: ask_user
description: Show the student a decision card with 2-4 options and wait for their choice. Use it for genuine choices (which board, which LED color, whether to replace their circuit), not for confirmation of every step.

name: highlight
description: Visually highlight parts, wires or pins on the canvas (with an optional short Spanish caption) to point the student at something while explaining.

targets.description: Part ids, wire ids or pin refs.

name: switch_view
description: Switch the main view: 'hardware' (realistic breadboard), 'schematic' (auto-laid-out circuit diagram) or 'software' (block editor).

name: load_example
description: Replace the project with a ready-made example (undoable). Ask the user first if their project is not empty.

name: new_project
description: Clear the project (undoable), optionally starting with a board and a breadboard already placed. Ask the user first if the project is not empty.
